text:
Karan (AE): Quick heads-up — StrataSys sent back MSA + DPA redlines for the POC. Main asks: customer-managed KMS (HSM), change payment terms to Net45, and an exception to the liability cap for regulated data. They want to sign this week. Procurement also says they need a PO before we flip the switch. @Maya can Legal sign off on the KMS language or suggest a safe alternate? Also who should be the final countersigner? :eyes:

Maya (Legal): Can you paste the exact KMS replacement they sent? I need to see what hooks/controls they added. If it's customer-managed but we retain audit/forensics access, that might be OK.

Karan (AE): Pasting the snippet they proposed:

```
Section 3.7 (Key Management): Customer shall provision and maintain Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) in Customer-managed HSM. Redwood shall have no access to plaintext keys. Customer grants Redwood the right to request temporary decryption access for incident response and regulatory requests, subject to Customer approval.
```

Maya (Legal): OK — two immediate flags: (1) "no access to plaintext keys" is fine but we need a narrow emergency access carveout (with audit trail) — propose adding an approval workflow and 30-day notice backstop. (2) The proposed phrasing could conflict with our backups/DR obligations. Suggest alternate text I can push quickly: 

```
Alternate 3.7: Customer may provision CMKs in Customer-managed HSMs. Redwood will not persist plaintext key material. In emergency scenarios (e.g., court order, incident affecting service integrity) Redwood may request temporary access; any such request requires Customer approval and will be documented in an auditable request log. Redwood retains the right to perform essential backups and DR operations consistent with the Agreement.
```

Liam (SalesOps): From ops/finance side — procurement insists on a PO before we enable POC billing. Net45 is not our default; finance needs explicit approval for extended terms. @FinanceBot any quick guidance? Also, docu-sign path: customer wants their legal + procurement countersigning before we countersign. We usually require customer sign -> our legal -> finance for billing signoff.

FinanceBot: Net45 requests for POCs require SalesOps escalation with pre-approved credit. Create a Billing Approval ticket and attach the signed/ redlined MSA. Finance will target 2 business days for review once PO is received.

Toni (CSM): POC timeline: engineering can stand up the environment by Tue if we have either (A) signed MSA + PO or (B) signed MSA + executed EAA (temporary) while PO is in process. Customer prefers full MSA + PO. If we can accept conditional activation (signed MSA + PO within 5 business days), that'll keep the timeline.

Maya (Legal): I can accept the alternate KMS text above provided we add explicit audit rights and a clause preventing key export that would violate export control/QS regs. Also need to preserve our subprocessor list language in the DPA. If @Karan confirms final redline today, I can approve and upload to DocuSign.

DocuSignBot: Envelope created: 0xFF12345. Signer order set: 1) StrataSys Legal, 2) StrataSys Procurement (PO upload), 3) Redwood Legal (Maya), 4) Redwood Finance (FinanceBot). Status: Draft.

Karan (AE): I'll send the alternate KMS text and ask customer to accept the conditional activation path (activation hold until PO lands). @Liam can you open the Billing Approval ticket and block activation until Finance signs? I'll CC Legal when I send. :+1:

Liam (SalesOps): Created OPS ticket OPS-7891 for Billing Approval + activation hold. Routing instructions: once envelope completes, Finance to verify PO number attached, then flip activation flag. I'll add a note to the ticket with the DocuSign envelope id.

Maya (Legal): Adding one more: require "no-export" and audit log retention clause in DPA addendum. I'll draft that now and drop into the DocuSign envelope.

Karan (AE): Perfect — I'll push to the customer now and confirm when they accept. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

DocuSignBot: Envelope updated: 0xFF12345 (added Maya's redline).

FinanceBot: Noted: will prioritize OPS-7891 after envelope completes.

Toni (CSM): Noted for onboarding — will prep the runbook but hold standup until we have PO.

Karan (AE): Follow-ups: will confirm acceptance time and post a short update here.
